wallBattlement.structureContract: Two separate full-height square battlement segments attach along the outside edge of a standard wall. Each logical footprint is exactly 64x64, so two adjacent battlements span exactly one 128-unit wall edge with no body gap or overlap and each occupies one quarter of a 128x128 wall cell by area. All bands and caps remain exactly 64 units along the wall direction; their relief may project only in the outward depth direction, preserving the exact two-per-wall rhythm. The high segment is 220 units tall and the low segment is 196 units tall; both clearly exceed the existing 160-unit wall, while their restrained 24-unit difference creates a readable firing notch. A dark separation groove and projecting datum band mark the standard wall-top height, and the raised portion adds front-face pilasters, a crown band and an outward-projecting cap so the parapet remains identifiable even with the same wall texture. The main wall remains the continuous walkable rampart behind them; each outer-edge battlement top is solid, blocked and non-walkable. Geometry, camera and scale remain identical across all five material tiers.
